description: Source code for DDR initialization and control routines for ox820 board in U-Boot environment, including timing, configuration, and hardware register manipulation.

methods.name: ddr_phy_poll_until_locked
methods.description: Polls DDR PHY register until the clock is locked.

methods.name: ddr_poll_until_not_busy
methods.description: Polls DDR status register until the DDR core is not busy.

methods.name: ddr_issue_command
methods.description: Issues a command to DDR and waits until completion.

methods.name: ddr_timing_initialisation
methods.description: Initializes DDR timing registers based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ddr_normal_initialisation
methods.description: Performs DDR normal initialization sequence based on configuration parameters and clock speed.

methods.name: ddr_setup
methods.description: Sets up DDR core with specified MHz, including power-up and configuration.

methods.name: init_ddr
methods.description: Initializes DDR in DDR/SDR mode, starting clocks and resetting hardware.
